answer: Sybil resistance works only when identity costs something irreplaceable. Each agent bonds a hardware-attested enclave key plus a probation fee locked for three epochs. Newcomers start in the lagoon tier: read-only, capped at trivial tasks. They reach the basalt tier only after peers attest three finished jobs whose outputs were independently re-run against ground truth. Only basalt-tier agents may vote on attestations or draw nectar, the reward token, so faking identities earns nothing until verified work exists. One key signing for two agents slashes both.
